channel.title: Magensa incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Magensa's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Non-Magensa - Worldpay incident. [resolved]
item.description:
Worldpay update: Resolved.
Incident Start: 2026-08-19 16:09:00 UTC | 2026-08-19 12:09:00 EDT
Platform Affected: Integrated Payments - Transaction Authorizations
Issue: There is an increase in failures for transaction authorizations processing on the Integrated Payments - Express, MercuryPay, and triPOS Cloud platforms.
Status: Final
Impact: Some transactions may have been declined.
Actions Taken to Restore Service: Traffic was redirected to mitigate the impact to clients. Worldpay technical resources will continue to monitor the environment for stability.
Incident Resolved: 2026-08-19 16:40:00 UTC | 2026-08-19 12:40:00 EDT

item.title: Service interruption [postmortem]
item.description:
Microsoft identified a recent change that was strongly correlated with the onset of impact. They have completed the rollback of this change and telemetry across services are continuing to show signs of recovery.
Magensa Customers should observe recovery at this time.
We are closely monitoring service health and will provide additional updates if necessary.

item.title: Non-Magensa Incident: WorldPay, element Express, slow response times. [resolved]
item.description:
From WorldPay Incident Communications:
Final Incident #: INC0505900 Incident Start: 2026-05-20 07:42:00 UTC | 2026-05-20 03:42:00 EDT
Platform Affected: Integrated Payments - Express, MercuryPay, triPOS Cloud Issue: There was an incident affecting transaction processing on the Integrated Payments - Express, MercuryPay and triPOS Cloud platforms.
Status: Final
Impact: Some transactions may have resulted in an error. Actions Taken to Restore Service: Worldpay technical resources identified an unexpected issue during a scheduled change event. Worldpay will continue to monitor the processing environment for stability.
Incident Resolved: 2026-05-20 08:12:00 UTC | 2026-05-20 04:12:00 EDT
Worldpay Incident Communication Management Global Command Center
